subject: Procurement kickoff & SE demo - Stellar Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement kickoff & SE demo - Stellar Health

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to get a formal procurement kickoff on the calendar so we can run through vendor onboarding steps (legal + SOC2/Security checklist), plus schedule a separate SE deep-dive/demo for your engineering team.

Can you confirm who on your side should be on the procurement call (procurement, security, legal)? Below are a few windows that work for our team next week: 
- Tue 2026-08-03: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-08-04: 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-08-05: 09:00–10:00 PT

Plan: 30–45 min procurement kickoff (onboarding steps, timelines, required evidence), then we can schedule a 60-min SE demo with your engineers once procurement is happy. Attendees from our side: myself (AE), Dev (SE), and Aditya (Sales Ops) as needed.

I attached a short vendor onboarding checklist to speed things up (see attached). If you prefer, we can split procurement and technical sessions on separate days.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@stellarhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & SE demo - Stellar Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — procurement and security would like to attend. Can you hold Tue 10:00 PT? That works best for our procurement lead. I attached our RFP and an initial vendor intake form so you know what they'll ask for.

Attendees on our side (tentative):
- Sofia Ramirez (Product)
- Alicia Chang (Security) — cc'ing
- Procurement team (procurement@stellarhealth.com)

We have a stricter timeline for onboarding: procurement needs SOC2 evidence and a data flow diagram before contract review. If you can share those docs ahead of the call, it'll help speed up the process.

Thanks,
Sofia
Product Manager, Stellar Health
sofia@stellarhealth.com
[Attachment: Stellar_RFP_SectionA.pdf (PDF)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@stellarhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & SE demo - Stellar Health

Hi Sofia —

Tue 10:00 PT works for me. For the technical/SE demo after procurement I recommend a separate 60–75 minute session with your engineering leads (deep-dive: architecture, request volumes, latency SLOs, data handling). Can you confirm the engineers' contact(s) so we can include specific demos?

I can bring a short tech packet and a sample data flow diagram — I'll also send our SOC2 summary and the standard security questionnaire in a follow-up email/drive link.

Options for the SE session (week of Aug 9):
- Tue 2026-08-10: 11:00–12:30 PT
- Wed 2026-08-11: 09:00–10:30 PT

If you prefer a single block, we can extend Tue's call to 90 minutes, but I recommend keeping procurement separate so legal/procurement can focus on contract items.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Quick note from Sales Ops:

If Tue 2026-08-03 10:00 PT is locked, I'll create a mutual action plan during the call and send a HubSpot link for milestone tracking (contract review windows, SOC2 evidence upload, PO timeline). For docs we typically need:
- SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months)
- Data processing addendum (DPA)
- Contact for KMS/keys if using customer-managed keys

I'll populate the HubSpot playbook during the call: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/987654
